from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](201)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(201, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        required = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.spy_closes.Add(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in required):
            return

        if self.spy_closes.Count < 201 or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        spy_sma_200_today = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(200)) / 200.0
        spy_sma_200_yesterday = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 201)) / 200.0
        spy_sma_50_today = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(50)) / 50.0
        spy_sma_50_yesterday = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(1, 51)) / 50.0

        spy_crosses_above_200 = (
            self.spy_closes[1] <= spy_sma_200_yesterday
            and spy_close > spy_sma_200_today
        )
        spy_crosses_below_50 = (
            self.spy_closes[1] >= spy_sma_50_yesterday
            and spy_close < spy_sma_50_today
        )

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below_50:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above_200:
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) // spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = shares

class IndependentDailyStrategies(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = []
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols.append(self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol)

        self.spy = self.symbols[0]
        self.aapl = self.symbols[1]

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200_ready = False
        self.previous_spy_sma_50_ready = False

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_has_bar = data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy)
        aapl_has_bar = data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl)

        if aapl_has_bar:
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        all_bars_present = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)

        fully_ready = (
            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_sma_200_ready
            and self.previous_spy_sma_50_ready
        )

        if all_bars_present and fully_ready:
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

            # Evaluate sells before buys.
            if (
                self.strategy_a_lot > 0
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma_50
                and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_b_lot > 0
                and self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_a_lot == 0
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
                and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            ):
                quantity = int(
                    float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40
                    / float(spy_bar.Close)
                )
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

            if (
                self.strategy_b_lot == 0
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
            ):
                quantity = int(20_000 / float(aapl_bar.Close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if spy_has_bar:

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value

from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategySystemAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](201)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](15)

        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None
        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_avg_gain = None
        self.aapl_avg_loss = None
        self.aapl_rsi = None

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return
            bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        spy_close = float(bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(bars[self.aapl].Close)

        self.spy_closes.Add(spy_close)
        self.aapl_closes.Add(aapl_close)

        if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
            change = aapl_close - self.previous_aapl_close
            gain = max(change, 0.0)
            loss = max(-change, 0.0)

            if self.aapl_avg_gain is None:
                if self.aapl_closes.IsReady:
                    total_gain = 0.0
                    total_loss = 0.0
                    for i in range(14):
                        difference = self.aapl_closes[i] - self.aapl_closes[i + 1]
                        total_gain += max(difference, 0.0)
                        total_loss += max(-difference, 0.0)
                    self.aapl_avg_gain = total_gain / 14.0
                    self.aapl_avg_loss = total_loss / 14.0
            else:
                self.aapl_avg_gain = ((self.aapl_avg_gain * 13.0) + gain) / 14.0
                self.aapl_avg_loss = ((self.aapl_avg_loss * 13.0) + loss) / 14.0

            if self.aapl_avg_gain is not None:
                if self.aapl_avg_loss == 0:
                    self.aapl_rsi = 100.0
                else:
                    rs = self.aapl_avg_gain / self.aapl_avg_loss
                    self.aapl_rsi = 100.0 - (100.0 / (1.0 + rs))

            if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        current_sma_200 = None
        current_sma_50 = None
        if self.spy_closes.Count >= 200:
            current_sma_200 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(200)) / 200.0
            current_sma_50 = sum(self.spy_closes[i] for i in range(50)) / 50.0

        fully_ready = (
            self.spy_closes.Count >= 201
            and self.aapl_closes.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.aapl_rsi is not None
        )

        if fully_ready:
            if self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
                crossed_below_50 = (
                    self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma_50
                    and spy_close < current_sma_50
                )
                if crossed_below_50:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi > 60.0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
                crossed_above_200 = (
                    self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
                    and spy_close > current_sma_200
                )
                if crossed_above_200:
                    quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                    quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = current_sma_200
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = current_sma_50
